description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targets” or “Untargeted” across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each year, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing “Targets” and an orange bar representing “Targeted.” In 2012, both the “Targets” and “Targeted” bars are very short, reaching approximately 2 and 0 datasets respectively. The “Targets” bar generally increases in height over time, reaching a value of approximately 158 in 2022, while the “Targeted” bar also increases, reaching a value of approximately 100 in 2022. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
